contract: Approved direction and constraints in ../BRIEF.md: bilingual editorial site for École Chrétienne Daniel, with a clear path to contact and no invented school details.

accessibility.evidence: The accessibility snapshot exposed named navigation, headings, landmarks and labeled controls. Keyboard focus showed a visible 3px outline; the mobile menu opened, closed with Escape and restored focus. Reduced-motion mode removed the reveal clip and parallax transform. Measured contrast ratios include ink/white 13.78:1, soft ink/white 7.09:1, blue/white 7.38:1, red focus outline/white 4.95:1 and yellow/deep blue 7.11:1.

responsive.evidence: Reviewed rendered captures at 390x844 and 1440x900. At 320px, document and body widths were 310px with no overflowing elements; the mobile menu remained usable.

loading.reason: The site is static and has no asynchronous content or loading operation.

empty.evidence: The gallery explains that school photographs will be added only after selection and the necessary authorization.

error.reason: The page has no dynamic data request or in-page operation that can fail; Facebook is an external destination.

partial.evidence: The unconfirmed phone number is explicitly identified; the official Facebook page is offered as the available contact route.

success.evidence: All seven sections rendered; French and English switching updated page language and translated copy, and the supplied logo loaded.

permission.evidence: The gallery states that photographs require selection and authorization before publication; no identifiable pupil photos are shown.

renderedEvidence.observation: The desktop opening shows the school identity, primary navigation, hero copy and contact/discovery links, with the next chapter beginning below.
The mobile opening shows the compact header, readable hero, both actions and the beginning of the motto chapter without horizontal overflow.
